sentences.zh: 就像是《挽救计划》那样吗？

sentences.en: Was it, like, this is never going to happen?
sentences.zh: 是不是觉得，这绝不可能发生？

sentences.en: But you just, like, what made you do that?
sentences.zh: 但你还是——是什么促使你那样做的？

sentences.en: Like, you just, like, it worked.
sentences.zh: 就像，你只是——结果成功了。

sentences.en: You actually did it.
sentences.zh: 你真的做到了。

sentences.en: You did the thing.
sentences.zh: 你把这事办成了。

sentences.en: But when you sent us that message, you must have thought, this is going into the void, right?
sentences.zh: 但当你给我们发那条消息时，你一定在想，这就像是石沉大海了吧？

sentences.en: And it's all on LinkedIn, and half of them are fake anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且全都在LinkedIn上，反正有一半都是假的。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, this is a cool idea because it's clearly not working.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，好吧，这是个好主意，因为现在这样显然行不通。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And one of my friends sent me the podcast and was like, Emily, you have to listen to this.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友把播客发给我，然后说，艾米丽，你一定要听听这个。

sentences.en: And that was before it came out.
sentences.zh: 那是它发布之前的事了。

sentences.en: So, I already had it in my head that, like, this was, like, my thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我心里已经认定，这个节目就是为我准备的。

sentences.en: And I was so excited about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: And multiple people had told me about it.
sentences.zh: 而且不止一个人跟我提过它。

sentences.en: And I just felt like, why not?
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，为什么不试试呢？

sentences.en: But I also remember thinking, like, I submitted a fan message.
sentences.zh: 但我也记得自己当时想过，我提交了一条粉丝留言。

sentences.en: And I'm really glad I also direct messaged you because now that I have access to the fan messages,
sentences.zh: 而且我真的很庆幸自己还直接给你发了私信，因为现在我有权限查看粉丝留言了，

sentences.en: I know that there's 3,000 of them.
sentences.zh: 我才知道那里有足足三千条留言。

sentences.en: So, it worked out that I reached out to you directly.
sentences.zh: 所以，我直接联系你的做法算是歪打正着了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: No, and we had other people reach out.
sentences.zh: 不，其实还有其他人联系我们。

sentences.en: We had other people message us, too.
sentences.zh: 也有其他人给我们发过信息。

sentences.en: For whatever reason, we just, like, felt like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但不管出于什么原因，我们当时就觉得，怎么说呢。

sentences.en: She seems like the right person.
sentences.zh: 她看起来就是那个对的人。

sentences.en: It was just like, it was a weird, there's, like, a weird little magical energy thing
sentences.zh: 那种感觉很奇妙，就好像带有一种奇怪而美妙的能量场。

sentences.en: that when something's right, you kind of sense it.
sentences.zh: 当某件事是对的时候，你大概能感觉得到。

sentences.en: So, it is cool.
sentences.zh: 所以，这很酷。

sentences.en: I think there's a cool lesson there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这里面有一个很棒的道理。

sentences.en: But I think it's so interesting to think about the show from, like, a Gen Z perspective.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得从Z世代的视角来思考这部剧，真的很有意思。

sentences.en: And I know Josh has talked about this, how it's very analog.
sentences.zh: 我知道乔希谈过这个，这部剧非常具有模拟时代的复古感。

sentences.en: And I think it's just so timeless in that way.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它在这方面可以说是永不过时的。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting to see my generation,
sentences.zh: 看到我们这一代人——

sentences.en: who doesn't really have as much of, like, a TV presence yet,
sentences.zh: 目前在电视上其实还没有那么多存在感——

sentences.en: kind of latch onto the show.
sentences.zh: 开始迷上这部剧，真的非常有意思。

sentences.en: And it's so cool to watch from here.
sentences.zh: 而且在一旁看着觉得太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And maybe, like, in the comfort of a time that was, like, a little bit simpler.
sentences.zh: 也许，就好像是在一种稍微更简单的年代里寻求慰藉。

sentences.en: Although, that makes us feel very old.
sentences.zh: 虽然，这让我们觉得自己非常老。

sentences.en: I also kind of like it.
sentences.zh: 但我其实也挺喜欢的。

sentences.en: Emily, that was amazing.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，太精彩了。

sentences.en: Bravo.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you, Emily.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，艾米丽。

sentences.en: We're happy you're here.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Yeah, we are.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们很高兴。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: I am guilty.
sentences.zh: 我有罪。

sentences.en: Please acquit me.
sentences.zh: 请宣告我无罪吧。

sentences.en: All sins are forgiven.
sentences.zh: 所有罪孽都被原谅了。

sentences.zh: 在纽约市。
